change_log.summary: The official comparison flags minor changes in compute/networking, management/deployment, and monitoring; it does not identify an exact bullet-level historical diff.

coverage_policy: One editorial competency per English skills-measured bullet; named examples remain in concepts. IDs are persistent editorial identifiers: do not renumber them when the guide changes.
scope_note: The guide describes representative skills, not an exhaustive list of all possible exam questions. Structural mapping does not mean complete teaching content or assessment coverage.
